place.zh: 沉鼎观 · 柴房 · 腊月初九
place.en: Chending Temple · The woodshed · Ninth of the twelfth month

_weather: 「一脚踢起一蓬雪末子」「一屁股坐在了雪地里」 — snow on the ground

setup.zh: 大比第二天，你从外门的大通铺搬进内门西廊。理储物袋，理出邹青松那只赤铜葫芦和七八瓣盾片——废物。
setup.en: The day after the contest you move from the outer court's long bunk to the inner court's west wing. Sorting the storage pouch turns up Zou Qingsong's red-copper gourd and seven or eight shield shards — rubbish.

recap.zh: 搬屋那几天，你把赤铜葫芦和盾片扔进饭桶，图个干净；它吐出一口剑，剑脊上自己刻着：火柴。
recap.en: The days you moved, you tossed the red-copper gourd and the shield shards into the Rice Bucket just to be rid of them; it spat out a sword with its own name cut in the spine: Matchstick.

zh: 一只空葫芦，七八瓣盾片——废物。
en: The day after the contest: moving house.
An empty gourd, seven or eight shards — rubbish.
Into the Rice Bucket, just to be rid of them.

story.zh: 搬屋那几天，他把储物袋倒了个底朝天，一样一样理，理出两样废物：邹青松那只赤铜葫芦，葫芦嘴敞着，肚里空空的；那七八瓣赤铜盾片，叮叮当当一小堆。
story.en: During the days of the move he turned his storage pouch upside down and sorted through everything, and sorted out two pieces of junk: Zou Qingsong's red-copper gourd, its mouth open and its belly empty, and the seven or eight shards of the red-copper shield, a small jingling heap.

label.en: Toss them into the Rice Bucket, just to be rid of them

exits.means: tosses the red-copper gourd and the shield shards into the Rice Bucket to be rid of them, wanting nothing; it chews, draws five breaths from him and spits out a plain sword, Matchstick — 剑起火升，攻守兼备 (the 大场面 扔了干净 plays it, setpieces/huochai.js)

_beats: 古七 (the per-回 plan, 2026-10-15): the feeding — 「心里什么也没想——扔了干净」, the chewing, a breath drawn each rest, the red light in the door. Since 2026-10-19 (Hanli: 「「扔了干净」这一幕改成大场面」) it is no board: the way on tells the book's two paragraphs and the chewing one is the 大场面 扔了干净 (`{景=huochai}`, setpieces/huochai.js); the old board (snow-fantong, row fantonghuochai) was deleted 2026-10-20 with the 饭桶's old play. The way on hands over 火柴 (a story thing) and tells the sword. 腊月十五's lesson moved to 09-jiuge.
